description: This file defines the PHP class 'jjwg_Address_Cache', which extends 'jjwg_Address_Cache_sugar' and provides functionality for managing address cache data, including loading configuration, retrieving cached address information, saving new cache entries, deleting cache records, and validating longitude and latitude values.

classes.name: jjwg_Address_Cache
classes.description: A class providing address cache management, mapping cache data to database operations and validation methods, extending the 'jjwg_Address_Cache_sugar' class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and loads configuration settings if $init is true.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads configuration settings using the Maps module and global configuration variables.

methods.name: getAddressCacheInfo
methods.description: Retrieves address information from cache based on provided geocode info or address string.

methods.name: saveAddressCacheInfo
methods.description: Saves new address geocode information into the cache table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: deleteAllAddressCache
methods.description: Removes all address cache records from the database tables.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Validates whether a longitude value is within acceptable geographical bounds.

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Validates whether a latitude value is within acceptable geographical bounds.
